Distinguish g gravity from bold residual g, nu specific volume from bold continuous variables, and phi porosity from POD basis. Signed reduced coordinates need appropriate MILP-domain mapping.

Read general MILP Eq1, compressible immiscible two-phase mass/Darcy laws, phase closures, finite-volume/implicit discretization, rate control, Newton solve and Eq2–5. Read snapshot construction, SVD, pressure/saturation split, mode selection, block basis, Petrov-Galerkin choice and Eq11–14. Snapshot-dimension text is inconsistent with phase block sizes. Reduced invertibility requires rank;normal-equation structure can be ill conditioned. Source explicitly admits reconstructed mass conservation may not be strict.

Read both daily chain/six-month reservoir grids, subset mapping, Eq29 and both claimed benefits. Flow-rate versus interval-mass/time basis is not unit complete as printed. Coarse average control does not independently constrain daily BHP/flow peaks or provide an actual buffer/inventory schedule.

Read single-cell Peaceman inversion, constant average mobility/density, pureCO2, BHP centre datum,90%fracture constraint, wellhead hydrostatic relation, constant pressure-loss approximation and plane-fitted pump Eq30–34. equations.expression: min f(v,w); Cv+Dw=e; v>=0,v in R^Nv,w in{0,1}^Nw
equations.interpretation: General standard-form MILP. Signed reduced states cannot inherit v>=0 without splitting/shifting or suitable native domains;not every physical variable is intrinsically nonnegative.

Compressible immiscible phase balance in surface-volume form. Distributed source normalization/volume differs from well-control vector rate and needs native operators;full constitutive/geometry/boundary data absent.
Multiphase Darcy law. K permeability,lambda relative permeability/viscosity;pressure/length and density/gravity yield velocity. Phase pressure,capillary and fluid functions required.
Fully implicit2Nb residual system for pressure/saturation and rate controls. The MRST well equations/control transformation are essential,not recovered from general law alone.

Literal derivative time indices differ from new-step residual;standard Newton needs current iterate Jacobian or an explained index/chord convention. Native method/convergence unverified;no code defect alleged.
First-order residual expansion around a converged training state. Training residual zero is assumed;nearby trajectories and valid Jacobians needed. Not an error bound outside training conditions.
Rearranges Eq6. J/A are2Nb-square andB is2Nb byNu. Well-control conversion delegated to SI;not merely taking a simulator Jacobian unchanged.
Original weighted metric. Later MILP drops saturation andgamma;this is an altered metric requiring validation,not an exact reformulation.
Relative reduced-saturation distance. Norm/coordinate scaling,near-zero regularization and epsilon units matter;term discarded in main MILP.

equations.expression: d_ci_(n,j)=sum_k |integral_0^tn u_k^n dt-integral_0^tj u_k^j dt|/(integral_0^tn u_k^n dt+epsilon)
equations.interpretation: Original cumulative-injection distance with current-volume denominator. Needs consistent rate/time/volume units. Later denominator is training volume and single-well sum omitted;nearest candidate can change.
POD reconstruction,with2Nb byl basis andl reduced states. Basis sign is arbitrary;physical state recovery is invariant under consistent coordinate sign changes.
Separate phase-block bases. Both phase fields have Nb rows;source snapshot text also gives2Nb for saturation,requiring dimensional reconciliation. Native bases and retained-energy criteria absent.
Test-basis projection of overdetermined linearized system. WithPsi=J*Phi it gives least-squares normal equations;rank/conditioning determine solvability. Full residual need not be zero.

Fixed-candidate affine update if reduced operator invertible. Synthetic matrices independently match least-squares projection. Candidate selection turns the full mapping into a disjunction;no native MRST trajectory reproduced.
Single-well absolute-distance split. Must use nonnegative components and a correct bounded binary-product encoding.
Literal continuous-distance times binary product;not linear until reformulated with valid finite bounds/indicators. V_j fixed training volume.
Complements Eq16. Together with nonnegativity enforces correct sign if products are implemented exactly;no actual native M or bounds supplied.
One nonnegative absolute-value component;does not alone guarantee exact absolute distance.
Second nonnegative component.
Upper constraints on candidate minimum. Need Eq21/22 as well;ties can admit more than one candidate index.
Binary-continuous products need linearization. With one-hot q and Eq20 it enforces selection of a minimum,butnative bounds/ties/endpoints remain unspecified.
One-hot candidate. A fixed-distance,bounded synthetic MILP component reproduces this minimum rule even when objective favors a different output;not a full variable-distance/native reservoir MILP.
Selection of known next training state. Initial/final search clipping and j+1 availability need implementation detail.
Selection of known previous training state.
One-hot selection of known inverse,not inverse of an arbitrary convex mixture. Products with other selected operators/states in Eq14 still need a complete disjunctive/linear encoding.
RHS literally retains i,notj;one-hot sum of a fixed-i operator does not explicitly select j-dependent operators. Preserve notation and check native code/errata,not silently repair.
Same fixed-i versus j-selection question as Eq26.
Same fixed-i versus j-selection question for training controls. Distinguish native printed expression from a separately constructed analyst selector.

Valid average volumetric rate if numerator quantities are per-interval masses;with mdot interpreted as mass rate the extra Delta_t changes dimensions. Native rate/amount/time convention must reconcile with Eq34. No corrected source input adopted.

Single-cell Peaceman approximation with mobility evaluated at training-average saturation and density evaluated at training-average well-cell pressure andpureCO2. Eq2 inline rho=b*rho_surface defines b inverse to prose here. Phase pressure,reference states and well-cell/pressure datum need native correspondence.
Six-month BHP constraint under approximated states/properties. It is not independently validated caprock/fault/thermal/peak-daily safety or a pressure-calibrated annual maximum rate.

Constant-density hydrostatic approximation. Surface reference density need not equal well-column density;real column uses pressure/temperature-dependent integral andconsistent datum. No source density guessed.
Fixed pressure-loss link. Source explicitly neglects flow/wellhead/pipeline-capacity interdependence,which it identifies as future work.

Bilinear rate-pressure power with consistent units. Native plane-fit bounds/coefficients/errors delegated to SI. Synthetic tangent plane has cross-term residual;not author pump-fit validation or total capture energy.
Phase closure reduces four phase fields to two primary variables. Capillary/relative permeability/density functions are not supplied in main text.
Reciprocal formation-volume definition implies b=rho_res/rho_surface. Prose accompanying Eq30 gives the opposite ratio;preserve both until native definitions resolved.
Phase mobility differs from total mobility in Peaceman approximation;native saturation/property averaging required.

equations.expression: J=partial g/partial x_next; A=partial g/partial x_previous; B=partial g/partial u_next
equations.interpretation: Derivatives of actual rate-controlled residual,including well equation elimination/conversion;dimensions2Nb square,2Nb square and2Nb byNu.
Three interior candidate points;endpoint clipping and units/scaling of regularization unspecified. Search size affects complexity and local extrapolation,not universal accuracy.

equations.expression: l=l_p+l_sat; l_sat=1; Phi_p/Phi_sat from leading SVD left vectors
equations.interpretation: Raw snapshot/SVD construction separates fields. No exact training snapshots,centering/scaling,energy threshold or tuning trace supplied.
Chosen projection produces Jr=(J*Phi)^T(J*Phi);full column rank needed. Claimed greater stability does not imply unconditional conservation or pressure safety.

equations.expression: Jr=Psi^T J Phi; Ar=Psi^T A Phi; Br=Psi^T B
equations.interpretation: Reduced operator dimensionsl byl,l byl,l byNu. Native Jacobians/basis needed for actual recurrence.

equations.expression: MILP distance=d_ci only,with training V_j in denominator
equations.interpretation: Drops saturation metric/gamma andchanges normalization. Toy ranking reverses forcurrent18 versus training10/30/50;intentional simplification requires scenario validation.
Analyst derivation of Petrov-Galerkin Eq13/14 normal equations. Synthetic implementation agrees with independent least-squares solver whilefull residual remains nonzero.

equations.expression: q one-hot and dmin<=all d_j,dmin>=selected d_j imply selected index is a minimizer
equations.interpretation: Analyst finite-candidate proof. Generic bounded indicator maps can encode piecewise affine updates;actual native variable-distance products/bounds are still missing.
Analyst unit identity. Literal Eq29 with already-rate inputs adds an extra reciprocal time;no native convention silently chosen.
Analyst linear-well example:mean-safe150 versus daily-peak200 atlimit162 in arbitrary compatible units. Coarse average does not guarantee peak feasibility;not a native field prediction.
Analyst physical comparison to constant surface-density Eq32. Chosen2/800kg/m3 and1500m are illustrative,not inferred native conditions.
Analyst exact bilinear interaction identity. Shows fit can over/underestimate depending on domain;native fitted plane may differ and remains unavailable.

equations.expression: conditional true/pmax=.9/.95 if predicted=.9pmax andunderprediction5% oftrue
equations.interpretation: Analyst margin example only. Source typically±5% well-cell comparisons are not a guaranteed BHP error bound or risk distribution.
Source-dimension arithmetic,not reconstruction of grid geometry,formation volume or retained mass.

equations.expression: standalone speed-up=reported full seconds/reported linear seconds
equations.interpretation: Recomputed rounded source timing ratios. Excludes a complete MILP solve,training cost and independent hardware benchmark;full-chain integration reportedly increases solve cost byorder100.

variables: x has2Nb pressure/saturation states;u hasNu well controls. The native case uses one rate-controlled well and6877 inferred cells. Geometry, units and functions are not reconstructed.

Sw+Sg=1 andpg=pw+pc(Sg). Primary pressure phase, capillary closure and datum must match native code. A distributed phase-source rate is not automatically the same quantity as a volumetric well control.
b is reciprocal formation volume factor, with rho=b*rho_surface. Eq30 prose describes the inverse ratio. Surface/reservoir states must be defined before well-flow conversion.
K is intrinsic permeability, kr relative permeability, mu viscosity andlambda_alpha=kr/mu phase mobility. Peaceman total mobility uses a training average, not every individual phase mobility.
Scalar g is gravity and bold g the residual;phi is porosity andPhi the POD basis;nu is specific volume and bold v the MILP variables;bold w contains binaries. Similar glyphs remain distinct.
J/A/B differentiate the residual with respect to current/previous states and controls. MRST rate control requires a well-equation conversion delegated to SI.
Phi is the pressure/saturation block basis;xi contains signed reduced states. Native lp=71, lsat=1, l=72. Basis signs are arbitrary;free reduced coordinates need explicit MILP-domain mapping.
Psi=J*Phi is the chosen Petrov-Galerkin basis;Jr=(JPhi)^T(JPhi), Ar=Psi^TAPhi andBr=Psi^TB. Rank/conditioning matters;zero projected residual does not imply zero full mass residual.
Training indices i/j differ from new timestep n. Interior searchS_n={n−1, n, n+1};initial/final clipping andj+1 availability require native implementation.

The original distance uses reduced saturation and current cumulative volume. The MILP uses training-normalized cumulative volume alone. Epsilon0.001 needs compatible units/scaling;it is not a physical error bound.
a is the sign binary, dpos/dneg nonnegative components, q one-hot selection anddmin the minimum. Products and selected maps require finite native bounds and exact indicator/disjunctive encoding.
Eq26–28 retaini inside a sum overj, unlike Eq23–25. Literal notation remains separate from constructed j-dependent toy operators.
T uses six-month reservoir steps;Tprime daily chain steps. n/nprime and|Tprime_n| map the grids. mdot is called a mass flow;Eq29 must reconcile rate/interval-amount and time conventions with Eq34.
u is a volumetric rate at specified surface conditions. t/day, kg/s and interval kg need explicit conversions. No unexplained timestep factor or native density is assumed.
pwell is well-cell pressure andpbh BHP at the single completion cell centre. pmax and its0.9 margin need consistent phase, depth, datum and gauge/absolute pressure bases.
pwh uses a constant-density hydrostatic approximation. A real column integratesrho(P, T)gdz. Synthetic2/800kg/m3 and1500m examples are not native P/T, density or depth inputs.
WI, C_CO2=1, b and mean mobility are treated as fixed. No multiwell, thermal, fault, brine-production or retained-mass calibration is demonstrated.
Pump outlet pressure is wellhead pressure plus fixedDelta_p;power ismdot*nu*Delta_p/eta. Pressure-loss/transport-capacity coupling remains future work. Native plane coefficients/domain are in SI.
Reported1–1.5kWh/t and20–40% are approximate dense-phase pump claims. They do not provide capture heat, power, liquefaction, cooling or a supplier-matched full inventory.
Typically±5% is selected absolute well-cell simulator agreement, not a strict BHP, buildup or global error distribution. Saturation, mass and leakage accuracy need separate verification.
Table1 endpoints, cumulativeMt and ramp duration do not identify plateaus, clock or integration arrays. Ramp duration and absolute attainment time are not automatically contradictory.

Table2 timing is standalone ROM selection/update/reconstruction, excluding the full MILP solve and training. Full-chain220532 continuous variables/94 binaries,94.39s,2% gap andorder100x solve increase are attributed values.
All synthetic matrices, selector outputs, residuals and unit/pressure/pump examples are analyst cases. They supply no native Jacobian, geographic proxy, annual physical rate or climate factor.
In Eq1,C andD are continuous/binary constraint matrices,e the constant vector,f the objective,andNv/Nw their variable counts. Geographic distance d has no native route-length array supplied here.

Standard SI dimensional interpretation:porosity,saturations,b,relative permeability and pure fraction are dimensionless;K is m2,viscosity Pa*s and mobility1/(Pa*s). A Peaceman WI of m3 gives lambda*WI in m3/(Pa*s),consistent with a surface-volume rate and pressure increment.

Pressure in plots is bar;1bar=1e5Pa. Pump power useskg/s,m3/kg,Pa and efficiency to give W. t/day needs1000/86400 to become kg/s. Native phase-source normalization,pressure datum and surface conditions remain unspecified.
